description: Golden reference for PEEC-inductance (coil only, STEP) on a 355deg gapped-torus coil.
rationale: Locks in the STEP-only centerline extraction + analytical TORUS sweep + n_peri=16 perimeter PEEC solve.  Regressions in extract_centerline_from_step dispatch (loft / TORUS / open-spine), unit auto-detection, or filaments_from_polyline fail loudly here.  The sample is a pure geometric problem so the expected L tracks the analytical formula tightly.

sample.comment: Cubit session in metres; STEP numeric values in metres but declared MILLIMETRE.  Unit auto-detect handles this from bbox diagonal.

reference_analytical.comment: Thin-wire self-inductance of a circular loop (Maxwell) adjusted for the 5deg gap.  Analytical assumes uniform current on a 1D filament.  Perimeter-placed PEEC with n_peri=16 underestimates by 3-5% (current redistributes to the outer perimeter, effective loop radius slightly smaller).

regression_guard.comment: Hard band: if L falls outside [80, 92], something broke at order-of-magnitude level.  2026-04-21 bug: filaments_from_step default cad_units_per_meter=1000 over-scaled metre-unit STEP, L dropped to 0.086 nH -- hit this band.
